summary.zh: 用 ADKAR 规划重组、转型与工具切换
summary.en: Plan reorganizations, pivots and tool switches with ADKAR

description.zh: 在推进重组、业务转型、更换工具、领导层变动或关停产品时规划落地路径。包含 ADKAR 模型、沟通模板和常见阻力模式。适合变化会直接影响一批人的时候。
description.en: Plans the rollout of a reorg, pivot, tool switch, leadership change or product shutdown. Covers the ADKAR model, communication templates and the resistance patterns that usually show up. Useful when a change lands directly on people's work.
